pages.title: Dairy
pages.text: Dairy foods strengthen bones and body. $(#e05252)Penalty:$() reduced knockback resistance when depleted. $(#52c252)Bonus:$() increased armor toughness when maintained. A single cow pen keeps this group topped up easily.

pages.title: Dairy — Herbs & Harvest
pages.text: Herbs & Harvest adds aged cheeses including Swiss, cheddar, and brie. These provide significantly higher dairy nutrition than plain milk and are worth crafting once your farm is established.

pages.title: Dairy — Vanilla
pages.text: Without Herbs & Harvest, milk bucket is your primary dairy source. Keep at least one cow nearby and bucket up regularly — it is one of the easiest groups to maintain in a vanilla world.
